posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on https://MCP.so (DR 74). You get a dedicated page for your MCP server and a backlink to your website.

Here is how:

1. Build an MCP server for your SaaS (ask Claude to build it for you).
2. Go to mcp .so and open the submission form.
3. Add your MCP server's name, description, website and connection details.
4. Pay the $39 listing fee and submit it.

A few notes:

I keep seeing AI cite MCP .so for MCP-related queries, so if you have $39 to spend, I think it's worth it.

Unfortunately, the website now looks like oversponsored slop. I usually skip paid listings, but this one gets cited often enough to be worth considering
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 MCP.so 构建 MCP server、打开提交表单添加 name/description/website/connection details、付 $39 提交，得到 dedicated page 和 backlink（DR74）。
